name: DDE WebAPI profile
abstract: DDE profile for resources that are web services: the described resource is itself a WebAPI, so @type must include schema:WebAPI. Composes ddeCore and the CDIF webAPI building block (potentialAction, termsOfService, documentation), and narrows schema:serviceType to a term from the DDE ServiceTypeCode codelist. schema:dataset carries the datasets the service operates on. Conformance URI: https://w3id.org/cdif/dde/1.0/DDEWebAPI.
